Soojin / Lauren — following Amit’s ask, I ran a quick sizing pass against BlueNorth’s telemetry. Short summary:
- Current committed throughput: 1.2M tokens/day average, peak bursts to ~3.4M tokens/day (historical Q4 spikes).
- Recommended committed baseline for next term: 1.6M tokens/day (roughly +30%).
- Burst design: recommend a staged burst pool (1.5x baseline immediate burst, with a separate overflow lane for critical campaigns up to 2.5x for short windows).

Pricing options to present at QBR (high level):
1) 12-month term: lower short-term commitment with higher unit price, includes 25% discount on burst tokens for first 3 months.
2) 24-month term: deeper baseline discount (15% lower unit), includes reserved burst buffer and 2 months of committed credit each year.

Action for commercial: can you get a draft price comparison for the two options (line items: baseline commit, burst buffer, overage rules, surge handling)? I’ll prepare a short runbook and SLO notes to attach to the SOW.

—Rishi
